report:
Apply complete — exact acceptance-contract repair

## Commit
- SHA: `a9e790399c165d743c6252c735b1b25879360e24`
- Title: `fix(recorder): enforce exact acceptance contracts`
- Parent/start HEAD: `72eb297aa8e144c8ceebbac71fdff7059fb34a70`
- Forward descendant: yes (strict); working tree clean

## Roots fixed
1. **Ordered lifecycle binding** (`src/recorder/extract.ts`): replaced bucket/≥1-terminal acceptance with ordered state machine `none → issued → started → terminated`; any contamination (duplicate issued/start/terminal including identical replay, start/terminal before prior phase, tool/args mismatch, error terminal) rejects that id; exactly one success terminal required; multiple complete acceptances throw `extraction-failed`.
2. **Exact acceptance text**: `contentText === acceptedTextFor(tool)` (no `includes`/substring).
3. **Closed Collector leaf** (`src/package-contracts/collector-output.ts`): recursive closed-key validators at root, report, leg, requestAttempt, snapshot, pageDiagnostics, and evidenceRecord; reject unknown keys and non-object/array descendants; keep `CollectorGeneratedOutput` legs-only distinct from accepted receipt.
4. **Audit provenance**: unchanged gate path — observation only from uniquely bound Judge/Reviewer acceptance (covered by new negatives).

## Tests
- Extended `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts`: tool×envelope matrix (replay, substring text, ordering, conflict/error/orphan, args mismatch, unsupported/bare, multi-candidate ambiguity fail-closed), Collector closed counterexamples + production-shaped accept control, Judge/Reviewer bound vs unbound audit.
- Harness `json-receipt` emits one terminal so e2e matches the exact-one-terminal law.
- `npm run typecheck` — pass
- `npm test` — 293 pass / 0 fail

## Scope
Touched: `src/recorder/extract.ts`, `src/package-contracts/collector-output.ts`, `dist/recorder/extract.js`, `dist/package-contracts/collector-output.js`, `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts`, `test/helpers/recorder-test-harness.ts`.
No Soul/role runtime/startup/admission/CLI/session-archive changes.
